ABOUT SUJI

Suji – Bridal Makeup Artist in Chennai

About Suji

Suji is the makeup artist behind RS Bridal, working with brides for wedding, engagement and reception functions. Originally from Trichy and primarily serving bridal clients in Chennai, she accepts venue-based bookings across Tamil Nadu based on date availability.

Her process is personal and practical. She understands each bride's preferred finish, then coordinates makeup with outfit, jewellery, function type and event style while keeping the preparation process friendly and comfortable.

Bridal Makeup Expertise

Suji's bridal expertise includes Bridal Makeup, Engagement Makeup, Reception Makeup, Bridesmaid Makeup, Hairstyling, Bridal Hairdo, Hair Extension support, Saree Draping, Mehendi and Groom Makeup & Grooming. Each service is planned based on the bride's look preference, outfit styling and function timeline.

A Personal and Comfortable Bridal Experience

Before every booking, Suji discusses the bride's preferred look, skin tone comfort and event requirement in detail. Makeup choices are coordinated with saree or lehenga styling, jewellery and function mood so the final look feels natural and event-appropriate.

She also gives separate attention to engagement, reception and wedding-day differences, and supports venue-based preparation where applicable so the process stays smooth and stress-free.

Makeup for Every Bridal Occasion

Wedding makeup is planned for long-event wear and photography, while engagement and reception looks are adjusted for function mood, outfit styling and lighting. Bridesmaid makeup is designed to complement the bride without overpowering her look.

For family-function bookings, RS Bridal can also discuss event makeup support for occasions such as baby shower or puberty functions where requested, using the same personalised approach to styling and preparation.

Friendly, Personal and Client-Focused Service

Suji discusses expectations before each function, understands the client's preferred style and adapts the look based on requirement and occasion. Her service style is professional, approachable and focused on helping clients feel comfortable during bridal preparation.

Awards & Recognition

Suji has been recognised for her work as a makeup artist and received a Scissors Award in 2026. The video captures the award moment and highlights from her bridal travel across different locations.

Serving Brides Across Chennai & Tamil Nadu

Chennai is RS Bridal's primary work area. Brides can also enquire for venue-based makeup and styling in Trichy and other cities and districts across Tamil Nadu, based on booking schedule and venue timing.
